name: Mobile Device
description: Personal mobile devices (phones/tablets) running dedicated user-facing applications represent a distributed endpoint layer with significant host-level attack surface. These devices combine personal and operational usage, creating exposure through weak authentication, unmanaged OS states, insecure application configurations, and physical access risks. Misconfiguration at the device level — rather than the application layer — enables credential theft, data exfiltration, unauthorized access, and malware persistence.
